items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: I bought the drums in New York from Maiters

ctx.x: in other words this set you have now would be quite a modern set modern set

now the first set I used was a 14 by 28 bass drum then I came down I went to New York and after I left the USO show I stopped at Bill Maiters here in New York Bill Maiters and Hall was together at that time wasn't together but Hall had pulled away from Bill Maiters and came down here and I bought the drums in New York from Maiters it was a 26 1426 I kept them about oh 10 years and after that I bought the this set here I bought a 24 I recall 26 but I said 26 when I went to New York I had 26 and I bought the 24 at…
you notice much difference in the tone the deep tone do you like the deeper tone or the smaller
